# Gula Restaurant (Cadaqués)

> Creative Mediterranean restaurant in the centre of Cadaqués (Costa Brava, Girona, Spain), a few steps from the sea. Recommended by the Guía Repsol 2026. Seasonal menu with Asian accents, fish and meat cooked over the coals, local produce. Average price 35-60 € per person (Guía Repsol).

- Address: Carrer Horta d'en Sanés, 4, 17488 Cadaqués, Girona, Spain
- Coordinates: 42.2892126, 3.2814082
- Phone and WhatsApp: +34 621 25 27 62
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/restaurantgula/
- Online booking: https://gulacadaques.myrestoo.net/en/reservar
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=5223975124710653241
- Guía Repsol: https://www.guiarepsol.com/es/fichas/restaurante/gula-334979/
- Website languages: Catalan (/), Spanish (/es/), English (/en/)

## Opening hours (bookings, may vary by season)
- Thursday to Sunday: Lunch 13:00-15:15, Dinner 20:00-22:30
- Tuesday and Wednesday: Dinner 20:00-22:30
- Monday: Closed

## Cuisine
Creative Mediterranean cooking that changes with the season: oysters, starters, sea and mountain dishes, fish and meat over the coals, and desserts. Signature dishes mentioned by the Guía Repsol: hake cheeks (cocochas) and suckling pig.
